resolution.note: worker-busy guard deleted; regression test: task create and claim with 5000 run entries

title: Task commands no longer refuse on a large run directory because the worker session guard is gone
body:
Why: assertWorkerIdle scans .krn/runs for a session.json that nothing writes since the worker left in #560 (ae42dab); with D23 eval results it exceeds 4096 entries and krn task create/claim/close exit 75 "too many run entries".
Outcome: worker-busy.ts and its calls are deleted; task commands run whatever .krn/runs holds.
Proof: a task CLI test creates a task with 5000 entries under .krn/runs.
Scope: src/task/, test/task/.
